recipe.variant: Qwen-Image-2.1 int8 + BFS head-swap LoRA v1.1 (strength 1): image_1 = the target, whose body, outfit, pose, light, background AND eye direction, head rotation and expression are kept; image_2 = the person's photo, whose face, hair, eye colour and nose are transferred; 50 steps
recipe.from_template: BFS 'Head Swap V1 Qwen 2.1 Workflow' (Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap), flattened to core nodes: its KJ resizes and 2 MP empty latent replaced by the encoder's own latent (the target's size), its optional Pruna 8-step LoRA and RES4LYF sampler replaced by 50 euler steps

prompt.note: the BFS prompt, kept word for word: it starts with the trigger 'head_swap:' and names <image1> (target) and <image2> (face) in that order. Gaze and expression come from the target, so set them in the step that made the target, not here.

resolution.note: 0 = each image at its own size (the author's). Qwen 2.1 shifts colour and softens the WHOLE frame a little; the author found a ~2K target reduces it

target.note: Image 1: the picture the person goes INTO, usually the still a person-from-reference step made. Its size is the output's; its gaze and expression are the output's.

face.note: Image 2: the person's own photo. A clear, well-lit face gives the best likeness; with several photos, use the one whose head angle is closest to the target's.

recipe.defaults_note: 50 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple, resolution 0, latent = the encoder's (target size), BFS v1.1 at 1.0. v1.1 is BFS v1 with the skin-softening MLP modules cut from blocks 16-31: more skin texture, the same identity and head pose. The 'alternative' file copies strong expressions better, the original v1 has the softest skin. FIXED: seed 31841, the BFS prompt word for word, no LoRA beyond BFS — only the two images change.
verify: Ran on Comfy Cloud (ComfyUI 0.38.2) on 2026-10-07 against the official 2.1 prompt-enhancer route on the same target: comparable likeness, kept the target's gaze and smile, the nose stud came through; 34 s vs 57 s, and no 9.5 GB enhancer file.

fixed.why: it is the workflow tested on Comfy Cloud (2026-10-07): at seed 31841 with the BFS prompt the swap came out clean every time; at seeds 0 and 42 (and with a reworded prompt) it came out as a crunched picture with the head not swapped — the same job with only the seed back at 31841 was clean

inputs.prompt: head_swap: start with <image1> as the base image, keeping its lighting, environment, and background. remove the head from <image1> completely and replace it with the head from <image2>, strictly preserving the hair, eye color, nose structure from <image2>. copy the direction of the eye, head rotation, micro expressions from <image1>, high quality, sharp details, 4k
